en.L: And it came about in the days of Ahasuerus (this is the Ahasuerus who reigned from India as far as Cush, over 127 provinces),
en.B: This is what happened in the days of Ahasuerus, the Ahasuerus who ruled over 127 provinces stretching from India to Cush,
en.R: This story took place when Ahasuerus was king. He ruled over 127 provinces, from India in the east to Cush in the south, beyond Egypt.

es.B: Esto sucedió en los días de Asuero, el Asuero que gobernó sobre 127 provincias, desde la India hasta Cus,

fr.B: Voici ce qui arriva au temps d’Assuérus, cet Assuérus qui régna sur 127 provinces, de l’Inde jusqu’à Koush,

sw.B: Haya yalitokea katika siku za Ahasuero, yule Ahasuero aliyetawala majimbo 127 kuanzia India mpaka Kushi,

vi.R: Câu chuyện này xảy ra khi A-suê-ru làm vua. Vua cai trị 127 tỉnh, từ Ấn Độ ở phía đông cho đến Cút ở phía nam, bên kia Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 아하수에로의 날들에 [이런 일이] 있었다. 이 아하수에로는 인도에서부터 구스까지 127개 지방을 다스린 [왕이다].
ko.B: 이것은 아하수에로 때에 있었던 일이다. 이 아하수에로는 인도에서 구스까지 127개 지방을 다스린 왕이었다.
ko.R: 이 이야기는 아하수에로가 왕이었을 때 일어난 일이다. 그는 동쪽의 인도에서 남쪽으로 이집트 너머의 구스까지 127개 지방을 다스렸다.

decisions.choice: Ahasuerus: the Persian king known in Greek as Xerxes (486-465 BC)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name Achashverosh matches the Persian royal name Khshayarsha, which Greek writers spelled Xerxes. Xerxes I, son of Darius I, ruled the Persian empire from 486 to 465 BC, and his empire did reach from the Indus to the Upper Nile. Ezra 4:6 places a king of the same name between Darius and Artaxerxes. The old Greek translation of Esther calls him Artaxerxes instead.

decisions.choice: from India to Cush: from the Indus valley to the land south of Egypt
decisions.reason: "India" here is the region of the Indus River in the far east of the empire (modern Pakistan); Cush is the land on the upper Nile south of Egypt (modern Sudan). The phrase marks the two ends of the empire, as 8:9 does again.

decisions.choice: provinces: districts of the empire
decisions.reason: The word means a district under a ruler's jurisdiction (Ezra 2:1; Nehemiah 1:3). The 127 provinces are smaller units than the empire's great satrapies (3:12; 8:9); Daniel 6:2 speaks of 120 officials over the kingdom.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into verses 2 and 3
decisions.reason: "It came about in the days of" opens the story, as in Ruth 1:1, and the main clause comes only in verse 3, "he made a feast". The words about Ahasuerus are a comment set inside it.

decisions.choice: in the east ... in the south, beyond Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable says where India and Cush lay so a new reader sees how far the empire reached.

decisions.choice: "Asuero"; "127 provincias, desde la India hasta Cus"
decisions.reason: The published Spanish form of the king's name, kept at every level for the whole book; meaning decision m1 says who he was. The number is in figures, as for every large total in Esther.

decisions.choice: No divine_name span anywhere in Esther, and "Dios" is never added
alternatives: Supplying God where the story implies his help
decisions.reason: Esther never names God, and the translation keeps that silence at every level of the Spanish, as the English does (see 4:14).

decisions.choice: Narrative in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced, the passé composé at Readable
decisions.reason: The usual tense of written French narrative at L and B; Readable uses the tense of spoken French and of school reading, as in Ezra and Nehemiah. This holds for the whole book; speech takes the tenses of speech at every level.

decisions.choice: "Assuérus"; no divine_name span in Esther
decisions.reason: The established French form of the name, kept for the whole book (meaning decision m1 identifies him as Xerxes). Esther never names God: French adds no span and no "Dieu" at any level.

decisions.choice: "Ahasuero"; "majimbo 127"
decisions.reason: The published Swahili form of the name, for the whole book. "Jimbo" (plural "majimbo") is the word for the provinces throughout Esther, with the number in figures after the noun.

decisions.choice: No divine_name span anywhere in Esther, and "Mungu" is never added
alternatives: Supplying God where the story implies his help
decisions.reason: Esther never names God; Swahili keeps that silence at every level, as the English does (see 4:14).

decisions.choice: "A-suê-ru"; "127 tỉnh"
decisions.reason: The Protestant tradition's form of the name, for the whole book; "tỉnh" for the provinces throughout. Esther never names God, so there is no divine_name span and "Đức Chúa Trời" is never added.

decisions.choice: Plain narration; the king is "vua" in narration
alternatives: "nhà vua", "ngài" for the king in narration
decisions.reason: As in Kings, the narrator speaks of the king plainly ("vua", "vua A-suê-ru"), without court honorifics; the forms people use when they speak to him are set at 1:16.

decisions.choice: "아하수에로"; "127개 지방"
decisions.reason: The established Protestant form of the name, for the whole book, and "지방" for the provinces with the number in figures. Esther never names God: no divine_name span, and 하나님 is never added at any level.

decisions.choice: The parenthesis about Ahasuerus becomes its own sentence
alternatives: One long sentence running into verse 3
decisions.reason: Korean cannot hold the Hebrew's long opening clause open across three verses; each level closes the sentence, while Literal keeps the opening "그리고 ... 있었다" for the Hebrew's "and it came about" (meaning decision m4).

source.text: בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם כְּשֶׁ֣בֶת׀הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ עַ֚ל כִּסֵּ֣א מַלְכוּת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּשׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַבִּירָֽה׃

es.R: En aquel tiempo, el rey Asuero gobernaba desde su trono real en la fortaleza real de Susa.

fr.B: en ce temps-là, quand le roi Assuérus siégeait sur son trône royal dans la citadelle de Suse,
fr.R: À cette époque, le roi Assuérus régnait depuis son trône royal, dans la forteresse royale de Suse.

sw.B: katika siku zile, mfalme Ahasuero alipoketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi katika ngome ya Shushani,

vi.L: trong những ngày ấy, khi vua A-suê-ru ngồi trên ngai của vương quốc mình, [ngai ấy] ở tại thành nội Su-sơ,
vi.B: trong thời ấy, khi vua A-suê-ru ngự trên ngai vàng tại thành nội Su-sơ,
vi.R: Lúc ấy vua A-suê-ru trị vì trên ngai vàng của mình tại hoàng thành Su-sơ.

ko.L: 그 날들에 아하수에로 왕이 수산 성에 있는 그의 왕국의 보좌에 앉았을 때,
ko.B: 그 무렵 아하수에로 왕은 수산 성채에서 왕좌에 앉아 나라를 다스리고 있었다.
ko.R: 그때 아하수에로 왕은 수산 왕궁에서 왕좌에 앉아 나라를 다스렸다.

decisions.choice: Susa the citadel: the fortified royal quarter of Susa
decisions.reason: Susa (Shushan) was one of the capitals of the Persian kings, in the southwest of modern Iran, where Nehemiah also served (Nehemiah 1:1). The word for "citadel" names the fortified palace area, raised above the rest of the city, which 3:15 and 8:15 call simply "the city of Susa".

decisions.choice: sat on the throne of his kingdom: was established as king and reigned
alternatives: sat on the throne for the first time
decisions.reason: To sit on the throne is to reign (1 Kings 1:46; 2:12). It may also suggest that his rule had now been made secure after the first years of his reign.

decisions.choice: Susa the citadel (Literal); the citadel of Susa (Balanced); the royal fortress in Susa (Readable)
decisions.reason: This wording is kept for the phrase throughout Esther.

decisions.choice: "Susa la ciudadela" (L); "la ciudadela de Susa" (B); "la fortaleza real de Susa" (R)
decisions.reason: Kept for the phrase throughout Esther; the city alone is "Susa".

decisions.choice: "Suse la citadelle" (L); "la citadelle de Suse" (B); "la forteresse royale de Suse" (R)
decisions.reason: Kept for the phrase throughout Esther; the city alone is "Suse", the published form (Ezra 4:9).

decisions.choice: "Shushani ngomeni" (L); "ngome ya Shushani" (B); "ngome ya kifalme huko Shushani" (R)
decisions.reason: Kept for the phrase throughout Esther; "Shushani" is the published form of the city's name (Ezra 4:9).

decisions.choice: "thành nội Su-sơ" (L, B); "hoàng thành Su-sơ" (R)
decisions.reason: "Thành nội" is the walled royal quarter, as the Hebrew word means (meaning decision m1); Readable says "hoàng thành", the royal city. Kept throughout Esther.

decisions.choice: "수산 성" (L); "수산 성채" (B); "수산 왕궁" (R)
decisions.reason: Kept for the phrase throughout Esther; "수산" is the published form (Ezra 4:9).

records.literal_gloss: in year three of his reigning he made a feast for all his princes and his servants, [the] army of Persia and Media, the nobles and [the] princes of the provinces [were] before him,

en.L: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and the princes of the provinces were before him,
en.B: in the third year of his reign, he gave a banquet for all his officials and servants. The army commanders of Persia and Media, the nobles and the officials of the provinces were present before him,
en.R: In the third year of his rule, the king gave a great feast for all his leaders and officials. The commanders of the armies of Persia and Media were there, along with the nobles and the leaders of the provinces.

es.L: en el año tercero de su reinado, hizo un banquete para todos sus príncipes y sus siervos; el ejército de Persia y Media, los nobles y los príncipes de las provincias [estaban] delante de él,

es.R: En el tercer año de su gobierno, el rey ofreció un gran banquete a todos sus dirigentes y funcionarios. Estaban allí los comandantes de los ejércitos de Persia y Media, junto con los nobles y los dirigentes de las provincias.

fr.L: la troisième année de son règne, il fit un festin pour tous ses princes et ses serviteurs ; l’armée de la Perse et de la Médie, les nobles et les princes des provinces [étaient] devant lui,
fr.B: la troisième année de son règne, il donna un banquet pour tous ses hauts fonctionnaires et ses serviteurs. Les chefs de l’armée de la Perse et de la Médie, les nobles et les hauts fonctionnaires des provinces se tenaient devant lui,
fr.R: La troisième année de son règne, le roi a donné un grand festin pour tous ses dirigeants et ses fonctionnaires. Les commandants des armées de la Perse et de la Médie étaient là, avec les nobles et les dirigeants des provinces.

sw.L: katika mwaka wa tatu wa kutawala kwake, aliwafanyia karamu wakuu wake wote na watumishi wake; jeshi la Uajemi na Umedi, watu mashuhuri na wakuu wa majimbo [walikuwa] mbele yake,

vi.L: vào năm thứ ba triều đại mình, vua bày một yến tiệc cho tất cả các quan trưởng và các đầy tớ của vua; quân đội Ba Tư và Mê-đi, các nhà quý tộc và các quan trưởng của các tỉnh [đều có mặt] trước mặt vua,
vi.B: vào năm thứ ba triều đại mình, vua mở yến tiệc đãi tất cả các quan chức và bề tôi của vua. Các tướng lĩnh của quân đội Ba Tư và Mê-đi, các nhà quý tộc và các quan chức các tỉnh đều có mặt trước mặt vua,
vi.R: Vào năm thứ ba trị vì, vua mở một bữa tiệc lớn đãi tất cả những người lãnh đạo và quan chức của mình. Các chỉ huy quân đội Ba Tư và Mê-đi đều có mặt, cùng với các nhà quý tộc và những người lãnh đạo các tỉnh.

ko.L: 그가 다스린 지 제3년에 그의 모든 대신들과 그의 신하들을 위하여 잔치를 베풀었다. 페르시아와 메대의 군대와 귀족들과 각 지방의 대신들이 그 앞에 [있었다].
ko.B: 왕위에 오른 지 3년째 되던 해에, 그는 모든 대신과 신하를 위해 잔치를 베풀었다. 페르시아와 메대의 군 지휘관들과 귀족들과 각 지방의 대신들이 그 앞에 모여 있었다.
ko.R: 왕이 된 지 3년째 되던 해에 왕은 모든 지도자와 관리들을 위해 큰 잔치를 열었다. 페르시아와 메대의 군대 지휘관들이 그 자리에 있었고, 귀족들과 지방 관리들도 함께했다.

decisions.choice: the third year of his reign: about 483 BC
decisions.reason: If Ahasuerus is Xerxes I, his third year began in spring 483 BC. Greek historians report that he gathered his leaders in those years to plan his war against Greece, but the text does not give the feast a purpose beyond showing his wealth (verse 4).

decisions.choice: the army of Persia and Media: its commanders
alternatives: the power (the chief men) of Persia and Media
decisions.reason: The word means strength, wealth or an army. Since these are guests at a banquet, it means the army's leading men, not the whole army.

decisions.choice: nobles: men of high rank
decisions.reason: The word is borrowed from Persian and means the foremost men; it occurs again only in 6:9 and Daniel 1:3.

decisions.choice: a feast: a drinking banquet
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "to drink". Feasts mark the story at every turn (1:5, 9; 2:18; 5:4; 7:2; 9:17-19).

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); leaders (Readable); servants: servants / officials
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in the Old Testament, the word sar is "princes" at Literal, "officials" at Balanced and "leaders" at Readable. The king's servants are his court officials.

decisions.choice: "príncipes" (L); "jefes" (B); "dirigentes" (R) for sarim
decisions.reason: The Esther wording for the king's princes, kept through the book; "servidores" and "funcionarios" for his servants at the court.

decisions.choice: "princes" (L); "hauts fonctionnaires" (B); "dirigeants" (R) for sarim
decisions.reason: The Esther wording for the king's princes, kept through the book.

decisions.choice: "wakuu" (L), "maafisa" (B), "viongozi" (R) for sarim; "watu mashuhuri" for the Persian word for nobles
decisions.reason: "Wakuu" is kept for the princes so that the rare loanword for "nobles" (meaning decision m3) gets its own wording.

decisions.choice: "các quan trưởng" (L), "các quan chức" (B), "những người lãnh đạo" (R) for sarim; "các nhà quý tộc" for the nobles
decisions.reason: "Hoàng tử" would mean the king's sons; these are his high officials. The wording holds through the book.

decisions.choice: "대신들" (L, B); "지도자" (R) for sarim; "각 지방의 대신들" (L, B), "지방 관리들" (R)
decisions.reason: "방백" is the older church word; "대신" is the plain modern word for a king's high officials. The wording holds through the book.

source.text: בְּהַרְאֹת֗וֹ אֶת־עֹ֨שֶׁר֙ כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְאֶ֨ת־יְקָ֔ר תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת גְּדוּלָּת֑וֹ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: in his showing the riches of [the] glory of his kingdom and the honor of [the] splendor of his greatness, days many, eighty and a hundred day[s].

en.L: when he showed the riches of the glory of his kingdom and the honor of the splendor of his greatness for many days, 180 days.
en.B: while for many days, 180 days in all, he displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the splendor and honor of his greatness.
en.R: For 180 days, half a year, he showed them how rich and glorious his kingdom was and how great and splendid he was.

es.L: cuando mostró las riquezas de la gloria de su reino y la honra del esplendor de su grandeza por muchos días, 180 días.
es.B: mientras durante muchos días, 180 días en total, exhibía las riquezas de su glorioso reino y el esplendor y la honra de su grandeza.
es.R: Durante 180 días, medio año, les mostró lo rico y glorioso que era su reino, y lo grande y espléndido que era él.

fr.L: quand il montra la richesse de la gloire de son royaume et l’honneur de la splendeur de sa grandeur, pendant des jours nombreux, 180 jours.
fr.B: tandis que, pendant de nombreux jours, 180 jours en tout, il étalait la richesse de son glorieux royaume, la splendeur et l’honneur de sa grandeur.
fr.R: Pendant 180 jours, une demi-année, il leur a montré combien son royaume était riche et glorieux, et combien il était lui-même grand et magnifique.

sw.L: alipoonyesha utajiri wa utukufu wa ufalme wake na heshima ya fahari ya ukuu wake kwa siku nyingi, siku 180.
sw.B: na kwa siku nyingi, siku 180 kwa jumla, alionyesha utajiri wa ufalme wake wenye utukufu, na fahari na heshima ya ukuu wake.
sw.R: Kwa siku 180, yaani nusu mwaka, aliwaonyesha jinsi ufalme wake ulivyokuwa tajiri na wenye utukufu, na jinsi yeye mwenyewe alivyokuwa mkuu na mwenye fahari.

vi.L: khi vua phô bày sự giàu có của vinh quang vương quốc mình và sự tôn quý của vẻ huy hoàng của sự cao cả mình trong nhiều ngày, 180 ngày.
vi.B: trong nhiều ngày, tổng cộng 180 ngày, vua phô bày sự giàu có của vương quốc vinh hiển mình cùng vẻ huy hoàng và tôn quý của sự cao cả mình.
vi.R: Suốt 180 ngày, tức là nửa năm, vua cho họ thấy vương quốc của vua giàu có và vinh hiển dường nào, và vua lớn lao, rực rỡ biết bao.

ko.L: 그는 여러 날, 곧 180일 동안 그의 왕국의 영광의 부와 그의 위대함의 찬란함의 존귀를 보여 주었다.
ko.B: 그는 여러 날 동안, 모두 180일 동안 영광스러운 왕국의 부와 자신의 위대함의 찬란함과 존귀를 드러내 보였다.
ko.R: 왕은 180일, 곧 반년 동안 자기 나라가 얼마나 부유하고 영광스러운지, 자기가 얼마나 위대하고 화려한지를 사람들에게 보여 주었다.

decisions.choice: the riches of the glory of his kingdom ... the honor of the splendor of his greatness: two paired phrases that pile up words for magnificence
decisions.reason: Each pair is a Hebrew way of saying "glorious wealth" and "splendid greatness". The heaped-up words suit the display they describe.

decisions.choice: 180 days: the length of the display, not of a single banquet
decisions.reason: The 180 days belong to the showing of his wealth, perhaps as officials came to the capital in turn. The feast for the people of Susa follows in verse 5 and lasts seven days.

decisions.choice: half a year
decisions.reason: Readable helps the reader feel the length of the display.

source.text: וּבִמְל֣וֹאת׀הַיָּמִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה עָשָׂ֣ה הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ לְכָל־הָעָ֣ם הַנִּמְצְאִים֩ בְּשׁוּשַׁ֨ן הַבִּירָ֜ה לְמִגָּ֧דוֹל וְעַד־קָטָ֛ן מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּחֲצַ֕ר גִּנַּ֥ת בִּיתַ֖ן הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And at [the] completing of the days the these, made the king for all the people the found in Susa the citadel, from great and to small, a feast [of] seven days in [the] court of [the] garden of [the] palace of the king.

en.L: And when these days were completed, the king made a feast for all the people who were found in Susa the citadel, from great to small, for seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace.
en.B: When these days were over, the king gave a banquet lasting seven days for all the people present in the citadel of Susa, from the most important to the least, in the court of the garden of the king's palace.
en.R: When those days were over, the king gave another feast for everyone in the royal fortress in Susa, from the most important people to the least important. It lasted seven days and was held in the courtyard of the palace garden.

es.L: Y al cumplirse estos días, el rey hizo para todo el pueblo que se hallaba en Susa la ciudadela, desde el grande hasta el pequeño, un banquete de siete días en el patio del jardín del palacio del rey.
es.B: Cuando terminaron estos días, el rey ofreció un banquete de siete días a todo el pueblo que estaba en la ciudadela de Susa, desde el más importante hasta el más humilde, en el patio del jardín del palacio real.
es.R: Cuando terminaron esos días, el rey ofreció otro banquete a todos los que estaban en la fortaleza real de Susa, desde los más importantes hasta los menos importantes. Duró siete días y se celebró en el patio del jardín del palacio.

fr.L: Et quand ces jours furent accomplis, le roi fit pour tout le peuple qui se trouvait à Suse la citadelle, du grand jusqu’au petit, un festin de sept jours dans la cour du jardin du palais du roi.
fr.B: Quand ces jours furent écoulés, le roi donna un banquet de sept jours pour tout le peuple présent dans la citadelle de Suse, du plus important au plus humble, dans la cour du jardin du palais royal.
fr.R: Quand ces jours ont été finis, le roi a donné un autre festin pour tous les gens de la forteresse royale de Suse, des plus importants aux moins importants. Ce festin a duré sept jours, dans la cour du jardin du palais.

sw.L: Na siku hizo zilipotimia, mfalme akawafanyia watu wote waliokuwako katika Shushani ngomeni, tangu mkubwa hata mdogo, karamu ya siku saba katika ua wa bustani ya jumba la mfalme.
sw.B: Siku hizo zilipokwisha, mfalme aliwaandalia watu wote waliokuwako katika ngome ya Shushani, tangu mkuu kabisa hadi mdogo kabisa, karamu ya siku saba katika ua wa bustani ya jumba la mfalme.
sw.R: Siku hizo zilipokwisha, mfalme alifanya karamu nyingine kwa ajili ya watu wote waliokuwa katika ngome ya kifalme huko Shushani, tangu wakubwa kabisa hadi wadogo kabisa. Karamu hiyo ilidumu siku saba, nayo ilifanyika katika ua wa bustani ya jumba la kifalme.

vi.L: Và khi những ngày ấy đã mãn, vua bày cho toàn dân có mặt tại thành nội Su-sơ, từ lớn đến nhỏ, một yến tiệc bảy ngày trong sân vườn của cung điện vua.
vi.B: Khi những ngày ấy đã qua, vua mở một yến tiệc kéo dài bảy ngày đãi toàn dân có mặt tại thành nội Su-sơ, từ người quyền quý nhất đến người thấp hèn nhất, trong sân vườn của cung điện vua.
vi.R: Khi những ngày ấy qua đi, vua lại mở một bữa tiệc khác đãi mọi người trong hoàng thành Su-sơ, từ người quan trọng nhất đến người thấp kém nhất. Bữa tiệc kéo dài bảy ngày và được tổ chức trong sân vườn của cung điện.

ko.L: 그리고 이 날들이 찼을 때, 왕이 수산 성에 있는 모든 백성을 위하여, 큰 자로부터 작은 자까지, 왕궁 정원의 뜰에서 칠 일 동안 잔치를 베풀었다.
ko.B: 이 기간이 끝나자, 왕은 수산 성채에 있는 모든 백성을 위해, 가장 높은 사람부터 가장 낮은 사람까지, 왕궁 정원 뜰에서 이레 동안 잔치를 베풀었다.
ko.R: 그 기간이 끝나자 왕은 수산 왕궁에 있는 모든 사람을 위해 또 잔치를 열었다. 가장 높은 사람부터 가장 낮은 사람까지 모두 불렀다. 잔치는 왕궁 정원의 뜰에서 칠 일 동안 열렸다.

decisions.choice: from great to small: everyone, of every rank
decisions.reason: The pair names the two ends of a range to mean all in between (1:20; Genesis 19:11).

decisions.choice: palace: a royal building or pavilion
decisions.reason: The word is borrowed from Persian and is used only in Esther (here and 7:7-8), of the king's palace with its garden.

decisions.choice: from the most important to the least
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means.

source.text: ח֣וּר׀כַּרְפַּ֣ס וּתְכֵ֗לֶת אָחוּז֙ בְּחַבְלֵי־ב֣וּץ וְאַרְגָּמָ֔ן עַל־גְּלִ֥ילֵי כֶ֖סֶף וְעַמּ֣וּדֵי שֵׁ֑שׁ מִטּ֣וֹת׀זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֗סֶף עַ֛ל רִֽצְפַ֥ת בַּהַט־וָשֵׁ֖שׁ וְדַ֥ר וְסֹחָֽרֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: White cloth, cotton and violet, held with cords of fine linen and purple on rings of silver and pillars of marble; couches of gold and silver on a pavement of porphyry and marble and mother-of-pearl and colored stone.

en.L: [There were] hangings of white cotton and violet, held by cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars; [there were] couches of gold and silver on a pavement of porphyry and marble and mother-of-pearl and colored stones.
en.B: There were white cotton curtains and violet hangings fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings on marble pillars, and couches of gold and silver on a mosaic floor of porphyry, marble, mother-of-pearl and precious stones.
en.R: White and violet cloth hung from silver rings on marble pillars, tied with cords of fine white linen and purple. Couches made of gold and silver stood on a floor laid with red stone, marble, mother-of-pearl and other costly stones.

es.L: [Había] colgaduras de algodón blanco y violeta, sujetas con cordones de lino fino y púrpura a anillos de plata y columnas de mármol; [había] divanes de oro y plata sobre un pavimento de pórfido y mármol y nácar y piedras de colores.
es.B: Había cortinas blancas de algodón y colgaduras violetas, sujetas con cordones de lino fino y púrpura a anillos de plata en columnas de mármol, y divanes de oro y plata sobre un piso de mosaico de pórfido, mármol, nácar y piedras preciosas.
es.R: Telas blancas y violetas colgaban de anillos de plata en columnas de mármol, atadas con cordones de lino blanco fino y de púrpura. Había divanes de oro y plata sobre un piso hecho de piedra roja, mármol, nácar y otras piedras costosas.

fr.L: [Il y avait] des tentures de coton blanc et de violet, tenues par des cordons de fin lin et de pourpre à des anneaux d’argent et à des colonnes de marbre ; [il y avait] des lits d’or et d’argent sur un dallage de porphyre et de marbre, de nacre et de pierres de couleur.
fr.B: Il y avait des tentures de coton blanc et des draperies violettes, attachées par des cordons de fin lin et de pourpre à des anneaux d’argent fixés à des colonnes de marbre, et des divans d’or et d’argent sur une mosaïque de porphyre, de marbre, de nacre et de pierres précieuses.
fr.R: Des tissus blancs et violets pendaient à des anneaux d’argent sur des colonnes de marbre ; ils étaient attachés par des cordons de fin lin blanc et de pourpre. Des divans en or et en argent étaient posés sur un sol fait de pierre rouge, de marbre, de nacre et d’autres pierres de grande valeur.

sw.L: [Kulikuwa na] mapazia ya pamba nyeupe na ya urujuani, yaliyofungwa kwa kamba za kitani safi na za zambarau kwenye pete za fedha na nguzo za marumaru; [kulikuwa na] vitanda vya dhahabu na fedha juu ya sakafu ya porfiri na marumaru na lulu na mawe ya rangi.
sw.B: Kulikuwa na mapazia meupe ya pamba na ya urujuani, yaliyofungwa kwa kamba za kitani safi na za zambarau kwenye pete za fedha katika nguzo za marumaru, na vitanda vya kuegemea vya dhahabu na fedha juu ya sakafu ya nakshi ya porfiri, marumaru, lulu na vito.
sw.R: Vitambaa vyeupe na vya urujuani vilining'inia kwenye pete za fedha katika nguzo za marumaru, vikiwa vimefungwa kwa kamba za kitani safi nyeupe na za zambarau. Vitanda vya kuegemea vya dhahabu na fedha vilikuwa juu ya sakafu iliyotengenezwa kwa mawe mekundu, marumaru, lulu na mawe mengine ya thamani.

vi.L: [Có] những tấm màn bằng vải bông trắng và vải tím, buộc bằng dây vải gai mịn và vải đỏ tía vào những khoen bạc và những cột đá cẩm thạch; [có] những giường bằng vàng và bạc trên nền lát đá đỏ, đá cẩm thạch, xà cừ và đá màu.
vi.B: Có những màn bằng vải bông trắng và những tấm trướng màu tím, buộc bằng dây vải gai mịn và vải đỏ tía vào những khoen bạc gắn trên các cột đá cẩm thạch; có những giường bằng vàng và bạc đặt trên nền khảm đá đỏ, đá cẩm thạch, xà cừ và đá quý.
vi.R: Vải trắng và vải tím treo trên những khoen bạc gắn vào các cột đá cẩm thạch, được buộc bằng dây vải gai trắng mịn và dây màu đỏ tía. Những chiếc giường để nằm dự tiệc làm bằng vàng và bạc được đặt trên nền lát đá đỏ, đá cẩm thạch, xà cừ và nhiều loại đá quý khác.

ko.L: 흰 면포와 보라색 천이 고운 베와 자주색 끈으로 은 고리와 대리석 기둥에 매여 [있었고], 금과 은으로 된 침상들이 반암과 대리석과 자개와 색돌을 깐 바닥 위에 [있었다].
ko.B: 흰 면 휘장과 보라색 휘장이 고운 베와 자주색 끈으로 대리석 기둥의 은 고리에 매여 있었고, 반암과 대리석과 자개와 보석으로 꾸민 모자이크 바닥 위에는 금과 은으로 된 침상들이 놓여 있었다.
ko.R: 흰 천과 보라색 천이 대리석 기둥의 은 고리에 걸려 있었고, 고운 흰 베 끈과 자주색 끈으로 매여 있었다. 붉은 돌과 대리석과 자개와 그 밖의 값진 돌을 깐 바닥 위에는 금과 은으로 만든 침상들이 놓여 있었다.

decisions.choice: white cloth, cotton and violet: hangings of white cotton and of violet-blue
decisions.reason: The word for cotton is borrowed from Persian and found only here. The verse begins with no verb: it is a list of what the guests saw.

decisions.choice: porphyry, marble, mother-of-pearl, colored stone: the stones of the pavement are not certainly known
alternatives: alabaster, white marble, pearl stone, black marble
decisions.reason: Each of these words is rare, and three appear only here. The renderings follow the most common identifications. What is certain is that the floor was a costly mosaic of several kinds of stone.

decisions.choice: couches of gold and silver: couches on which guests reclined to eat and drink
decisions.reason: Guests at royal banquets reclined on couches (7:8). Greek historians describe the gold and silver couches of the Persian kings.

decisions.choice: red stone (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what porphyry is, a purple-red stone, rather than use a rare English word.

decisions.choice: "porfiri" (L, B); "mawe mekundu" (R)
decisions.reason: Swahili has no common word for porphyry; L and B borrow the name, and Readable says what it is, a red stone, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "giường" for the couches; Readable adds "để nằm dự tiệc"
decisions.reason: Guests reclined to eat (meaning decision m3), so the word is a bed-like couch; Readable says what it was for.

decisions.choice: "침상" for the couches; "반암" (L, B), "붉은 돌" (R) for porphyry
decisions.reason: Guests reclined on these couches (meaning decision m3); Readable names porphyry by its colour, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְהַשְׁקוֹת֙ בִּכְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְכֵלִ֖ים מִכֵּלִ֣ים שׁוֹנִ֑ים וְיֵ֥ין מַלְכ֛וּת רָ֖ב כְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [they] gave drink in vessels of gold, and vessels from vessels differing, and wine of royalty [was] much, according to [the] hand of the king.

en.L: And drinks were served in vessels of gold, vessels differing from one another, and the royal wine was plentiful, according to the hand of the king.
en.B: Drinks were served in gold cups, each one different from the others, and royal wine flowed freely, as the king's generosity allowed.
en.R: The guests drank from gold cups, and no two cups were alike. There was plenty of the king's own wine, because the king was very generous.

es.L: Y se daba de beber en vasos de oro, vasos diferentes unos de otros, y el vino real [era] abundante, conforme a la mano del rey.
es.B: Se servían las bebidas en copas de oro, cada una distinta de las demás, y el vino real corría en abundancia, como lo permitía la generosidad del rey.
es.R: Los invitados bebían en copas de oro, y no había dos copas iguales. Había mucho vino del rey, porque el rey era muy generoso.

fr.L: Et l’on donnait à boire dans des vases d’or, des vases différents les uns des autres, et le vin royal [était] abondant, selon la main du roi.
fr.B: On servait à boire dans des coupes d’or, toutes différentes les unes des autres, et le vin royal coulait en abondance, selon la générosité du roi.
fr.R: Les invités buvaient dans des coupes en or, et aucune coupe ne ressemblait à une autre. Il y avait beaucoup de vin du roi, car le roi était très généreux.

sw.L: Wakanywesha katika vyombo vya dhahabu, vyombo vilivyotofautiana kimoja na kingine, na divai ya kifalme [ilikuwa] nyingi, kwa kadiri ya mkono wa mfalme.
sw.B: Vinywaji vilitolewa katika vikombe vya dhahabu, kila kimoja tofauti na vingine, na divai ya kifalme ilikuwa tele, kwa kadiri ya ukarimu wa mfalme.
sw.R: Wageni walikunywa katika vikombe vya dhahabu, na hapakuwa na vikombe viwili vilivyofanana. Kulikuwa na divai nyingi ya mfalme mwenyewe, kwa sababu mfalme alikuwa mkarimu sana.

vi.L: Và người ta cho uống bằng những chén vàng, những chén khác nhau, và rượu của vua [thì] nhiều, theo tay của vua.
vi.B: Rượu được rót trong những chén vàng, chén nào cũng khác chén nào, và rượu ngự tràn trề, xứng với lòng hào phóng của vua.
vi.R: Khách uống bằng những chén vàng, không có hai chén nào giống nhau. Có rất nhiều rượu của chính vua, vì vua rất rộng rãi.

ko.L: 그리고 금 그릇들로 마시게 하였는데, 그릇들이 서로 달랐고, 왕의 포도주가 왕의 손에 따라 많았다.
ko.B: 마실 것은 금잔에 담아 내었는데 잔마다 모양이 달랐고, 왕의 포도주는 왕의 너그러움에 걸맞게 넉넉했다.
ko.R: 손님들은 금잔으로 마셨는데, 똑같은 잔이 하나도 없었다. 왕이 매우 너그러웠기 때문에 왕의 포도주도 넉넉했다.

decisions.choice: according to the hand of the king: as the king's wealth and generosity allowed
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and means; the phrase returns in 2:18 for the king's gifts (compare 1 Kings 10:13).

decisions.choice: wine of royalty: wine from the king's own supply
decisions.reason: The phrase means the king's own wine, of the quality fit for a king.

decisions.choice: as the king's generosity allowed (Balanced); because the king was very generous (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable explain the idiom; Literal keeps "hand".

source.text: וְהַשְּׁתִיָּ֥ה כַדָּ֖ת אֵ֣ין אֹנֵ֑ס כִּי־כֵ֣ן׀יִסַּ֣ד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַ֚ל כָּל־רַ֣ב בֵּית֔וֹ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת כִּרְצ֥וֹן אִישׁ־וָאִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the drinking [was] according to the law; there [was] no one compelling, for so had appointed the king on every chief of his house, to do according to [the] pleasure of man and man.

en.L: And the drinking was according to the law; no one compelled, for so the king had ordered every officer of his house: to do according to the wish of each man.
en.B: By the king's rule for the drinking, no one was forced to drink, for the king had instructed all the officials of his household to let each guest do as he wished.
en.R: The king had made a rule that no one had to drink more than he wanted. He told all the servants in charge of his palace to let each guest drink as much or as little as he liked.

es.L: Y la bebida [era] conforme a la ley; nadie obligaba, porque así lo había ordenado el rey a todo jefe de su casa: que hicieran conforme al deseo de cada hombre.
es.B: Según la norma del rey para la bebida, a nadie se obligaba a beber, porque el rey había dado instrucciones a todos los oficiales de su casa de que dejaran a cada invitado hacer lo que quisiera.
es.R: El rey había dado una orden: nadie tenía que beber más de lo que quería. Les dijo a todos los sirvientes encargados de su palacio que dejaran a cada invitado beber mucho o poco, como quisiera.

fr.L: Et la boisson [était] selon la loi ; personne ne contraignait, car ainsi le roi l’avait prescrit à tout chef de sa maison : faire selon le désir de chacun.
fr.B: Selon la règle fixée par le roi pour la boisson, personne n’était forcé de boire, car le roi avait ordonné à tous les intendants de sa maison de laisser chaque invité faire comme il le voulait.
fr.R: Le roi avait fixé une règle : personne n’était obligé de boire plus qu’il ne le voulait. Il avait dit à tous les serviteurs responsables de son palais de laisser chaque invité boire autant ou aussi peu qu’il le désirait.

sw.L: Na kunywa [kulikuwa] kwa kufuata sheria; hakuna aliyelazimisha, kwa maana ndivyo mfalme alivyokuwa amemwagiza kila msimamizi wa nyumba yake: kufanya kwa kadiri ya mapenzi ya kila mtu.
sw.B: Kwa agizo la mfalme kuhusu kunywa, hakuna aliyelazimishwa kunywa, kwa maana mfalme alikuwa amewaagiza maafisa wote wa nyumba yake wamwache kila mgeni afanye apendavyo.
sw.R: Mfalme alikuwa ameweka agizo kwamba hakuna mtu atakayelazimishwa kunywa zaidi ya alivyotaka. Aliwaambia watumishi wote waliosimamia jumba lake wamwache kila mgeni anywe kiasi alichopenda, kingi au kidogo.

vi.L: Và việc uống [thì] theo luật; không ai ép buộc, vì vua đã truyền như vậy cho mọi quan cai trong cung mình: làm theo ý muốn của mỗi người.
vi.B: Theo lệnh vua về việc uống rượu, không ai bị ép uống, vì vua đã dặn mọi quan quản lý trong cung để cho mỗi vị khách được tùy ý.
vi.R: Vua đã ra lệnh: không ai bị bắt phải uống quá ý mình. Vua dặn tất cả những người phụ trách trong cung để mỗi vị khách uống nhiều hay ít tùy thích.

ko.L: 그리고 마시는 것은 법대로 [하였다]. 강요하는 자가 없었으니, 왕이 그의 궁의 모든 책임자에게 각 사람의 뜻대로 하게 하라고 그렇게 정해 두었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 왕이 정한 규례에 따라 아무도 억지로 마시게 하지 않았다. 왕이 궁중의 모든 관리에게 손님마다 원하는 대로 하게 하라고 지시해 두었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 왕은 아무도 원하는 것보다 더 마시지 않아도 된다는 규칙을 정했다. 그리고 궁궐 일을 맡은 모든 신하에게 손님마다 마시고 싶은 만큼만 마시게 하라고 일렀다.

decisions.choice: the law: the rule set for this feast
decisions.reason: The word dat, borrowed from Persian, means a royal law, decree or rule, and is a key word in Esther (1:13, 15, 19; 3:8; 4:16). Here it is the king's order for the banquet, as the rest of the verse explains. The book shows Persian law reaching even into how much guests drank.

decisions.choice: no one compelled: no guest was forced to drink
decisions.reason: The verb means to force or press. Each guest drank as much as he wished, neither forced to drink more nor held back.

decisions.choice: every chief of his house: the stewards of the royal household
decisions.reason: The phrase means the officials in charge of the palace staff, who served the wine.

decisions.choice: each guest ... as he wished
decisions.reason: The guests at this feast were men (Vashti gave a separate feast for women, verse 9), so no gender span is used.

decisions.choice: "ley" (L); "norma" (B); "orden" (R) for dat
decisions.reason: The Persian word dat is a key word in Esther (meaning decision m1); here it is the rule for the banquet, so Balanced and Readable use the lighter word, while Literal keeps "ley" so the reader sees it is the same word as in 1:13, 15, 19.

source.text: גַּ֚ם וַשְׁתִּ֣י הַמַּלְכָּ֔ה עָשְׂתָ֖ה מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה נָשִׁ֑ים בֵּ֚ית הַמַּלְכ֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Also Vashti the queen made a feast [for] women [in the] house of the royalty which [was] to the king Ahasuerus.

en.L: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house that belonged to King Ahasuerus.
en.B: Queen Vashti also gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace of King Ahasuerus.
en.R: At the same time Queen Vashti gave a feast for the women in King Ahasuerus's palace.

es.L: También la reina Vasti hizo un banquete para las mujeres en la casa real que [pertenecía] al rey Asuero.
es.B: También la reina Vasti ofreció un banquete a las mujeres en el palacio real del rey Asuero.
es.R: Al mismo tiempo, la reina Vasti ofreció un banquete a las mujeres en el palacio del rey Asuero.

fr.L: Aussi Vashti la reine fit un festin pour les femmes dans la maison royale qui [était] au roi Assuérus.
fr.B: La reine Vashti donna, elle aussi, un banquet pour les femmes dans le palais royal du roi Assuérus.
fr.R: Pendant ce temps, la reine Vashti a donné un festin pour les femmes dans le palais du roi Assuérus.

sw.L: Pia Vashti malkia akawafanyia wanawake karamu katika nyumba ya kifalme iliyokuwa ya mfalme Ahasuero.
sw.B: Malkia Vashti naye aliwaandalia wanawake karamu katika jumba la kifalme la mfalme Ahasuero.
sw.R: Wakati huo huo malkia Vashti aliwafanyia wanawake karamu katika jumba la mfalme Ahasuero.

vi.L: Hoàng hậu Vả-thi cũng bày một yến tiệc cho các phụ nữ trong cung điện hoàng gia thuộc về vua A-suê-ru.
vi.B: Hoàng hậu Vả-thi cũng mở yến tiệc đãi các phụ nữ trong cung điện của vua A-suê-ru.
vi.R: Cùng lúc đó, hoàng hậu Vả-thi mở tiệc đãi các phụ nữ trong cung điện của vua A-suê-ru.

ko.L: 왕후 와스디도 아하수에로 왕에게 속한 왕궁에서 여자들을 위하여 잔치를 베풀었다.
ko.B: 왕후 와스디도 아하수에로 왕의 왕궁에서 여자들을 위해 잔치를 베풀었다.
ko.R: 같은 때에 왕후 와스디도 아하수에로 왕의 궁궐에서 여자들을 위해 잔치를 열었다.

decisions.choice: Vashti the queen: the king's chief wife
decisions.reason: Vashti is known only from Esther. Her name may come from a Persian word for "best" or "beloved". Greek historians name Amestris as the wife of Xerxes, and how the two accounts relate is not known.

decisions.choice: a feast for the women: a separate banquet for the women of the court
decisions.reason: The women held their own feast in the palace while the men feasted in the garden court (verse 5). This sets up the king's summons in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "hoàng hậu Vả-thi"
decisions.reason: "Nữ hoàng" is a reigning queen; Vashti is the king's chief wife, "hoàng hậu", the title kept for her and for Esther through the book.

source.text: בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י כְּט֥וֹב לֵב־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בַּיָּ֑יִן אָמַ֡ר לִ֠מְהוּמָן בִּזְּתָ֨א חַרְבוֹנָ֜א בִּגְתָ֤א וַאֲבַגְתָא֙ זֵתַ֣ר וְכַרְכַּ֔ס שִׁבְעַת֙ הַסָּ֣רִיסִ֔ים הַמְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: On the day the seventh, when good [was the] heart of the king with wine, he said to Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha and Abagtha, Zethar and Carcas, [the] seven [of] the eunuchs who served [before the] face of the king Ahasuerus,

en.L: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he said to Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha and Abagtha, Zethar and Carcas, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of King Ahasuerus,
en.B: On the seventh day, when the king was in high spirits from the wine, he ordered Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar and Carcas, the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus personally,
en.R: On the seventh day of the feast, the king had been drinking and was in a cheerful mood. He gave an order to the seven palace officials who served him personally: Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar and Carcas.

es.L: En el séptimo día, cuando el corazón del rey estaba alegre por el vino, dijo a Mehumán, Bizta, Harbona, Bigta y Abagta, Zetar y Carcas, los siete eunucos que servían delante del rey Asuero,
es.B: El séptimo día, cuando el rey estaba alegre por el vino, ordenó a Mehumán, Bizta, Harbona, Bigta, Abagta, Zetar y Carcas, los siete eunucos que servían personalmente al rey Asuero,
es.R: El séptimo día del banquete, el rey había estado bebiendo y estaba de muy buen humor. Dio una orden a los siete funcionarios del palacio que lo servían personalmente: Mehumán, Bizta, Harbona, Bigta, Abagta, Zetar y Carcas.

fr.L: Le septième jour, comme le cœur du roi était joyeux par le vin, il dit à Mehoumân, Bizzetha, Harbona, Bigtha et Abagtha, Zéthar et Karkas, les sept eunuques qui servaient devant la face du roi Assuérus,
fr.B: Le septième jour, comme le vin avait mis le roi de belle humeur, il ordonna à Mehoumân, Bizzetha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zéthar et Karkas, les sept eunuques qui servaient personnellement le roi Assuérus,
fr.R: Le septième jour de la fête, le roi avait bu et il était de très bonne humeur. Il a donné un ordre aux sept officiers du palais qui le servaient personnellement : Mehoumân, Bizzetha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zéthar et Karkas.

sw.L: Siku ya saba, moyo wa mfalme ulipokuwa umefurahishwa na divai, akawaambia Mehumani, Bizetha, Harbona, Bigtha na Abagtha, Zethari na Karkasi, matowashi saba waliohudumu mbele ya uso wa mfalme Ahasuero,
sw.B: Siku ya saba, mfalme alipokuwa amechangamka kwa divai, aliwaamuru Mehumani, Bizetha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethari na Karkasi, matowashi saba waliomhudumia mfalme Ahasuero yeye binafsi,
sw.R: Siku ya saba ya karamu, mfalme alikuwa amekunywa divai, naye alikuwa mchangamfu sana. Akawapa amri maafisa saba wa ikulu waliomhudumia yeye binafsi: Mehumani, Bizetha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethari na Karkasi.

vi.L: Vào ngày thứ bảy, khi lòng vua vui vì rượu, vua bảo Mê-hu-man, Bít-tha, Hạt-bô-na, Bích-tha và A-bác-tha, Xê-tha và Cạt-cách, bảy hoạn quan hầu việc trước mặt vua A-suê-ru,
vi.B: Vào ngày thứ bảy, khi rượu đã làm vua vui vẻ, vua truyền cho Mê-hu-man, Bít-tha, Hạt-bô-na, Bích-tha, A-bác-tha, Xê-tha và Cạt-cách, là bảy hoạn quan hầu cận vua A-suê-ru,
vi.R: Vào ngày thứ bảy của bữa tiệc, vua đã uống rượu và rất vui. Vua ra lệnh cho bảy quan chức trong cung chuyên hầu cận vua: Mê-hu-man, Bít-tha, Hạt-bô-na, Bích-tha, A-bác-tha, Xê-tha và Cạt-cách.

ko.L: 일곱째 날에 왕의 마음이 포도주로 즐거워졌을 때, 그가 아하수에로 왕의 얼굴 앞에서 섬기는 일곱 내시인 므후만과 비스다와 하르보나와 빅다와 아박다와 세달과 가르가스에게 말하여,
ko.B: 일곱째 날, 왕은 포도주를 마시고 기분이 좋아지자, 아하수에로 왕을 가까이에서 모시는 일곱 내시 므후만, 비스다, 하르보나, 빅다, 아박다, 세달, 가르가스에게 명령하여,
ko.R: 잔치 일곱째 날, 왕은 술을 마시고 기분이 매우 좋아졌다. 그래서 자기를 가까이에서 모시는 궁중 관리 일곱 사람에게 명령을 내렸다. 그들은 므후만, 비스다, 하르보나, 빅다, 아박다, 세달, 가르가스였다.

decisions.choice: eunuchs: castrated men serving at court; the word can also mean a court official
decisions.reason: The word saris can mean simply a royal officer (Genesis 37:36 uses it of Potiphar, who was married). But men who served in the harem and in the king's private rooms, as these men do (2:3, 14), were eunuchs, as was the custom in the Persian court. This book uses the word for such servants throughout.

decisions.choice: when the heart of the king was good with wine: when the wine had made him merry
decisions.reason: A good heart is a cheerful mood; with wine it means he was well on the way to being drunk (1 Samuel 25:36; 2 Samuel 13:28). The king's order comes from the wine, not from careful thought.

decisions.choice: who served the face of the king: his personal attendants
decisions.reason: To serve before someone's face is to wait on him in person.

decisions.choice: eunuchs (Literal, Balanced); palace officials (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the more general sense of the word, which a new reader can follow; Literal and Balanced keep "eunuchs", which says what these servants were.

decisions.choice: "eunucos" (L, B); "funcionarios del palacio" (R)
decisions.reason: The Esther wording for saris, kept through the book, as the English and meaning decision m1.

decisions.choice: "eunuques" (L, B); "officiers du palais" (R)
decisions.reason: The Esther wording for saris, kept through the book, as the English and meaning decision m1.

decisions.choice: "matowashi" (L, B); "maafisa wa ikulu" (R)
decisions.reason: The Esther wording for saris, kept through the book, as in Kings.

decisions.choice: "hoạn quan" (L, B); "quan chức trong cung" (R)
decisions.reason: "Hoạn quan" is the plain word for a castrated court servant; "thái giám" belongs to the Chinese court. Kept through the book.

decisions.choice: "내시" (L, B); "궁중 관리" (R)
decisions.reason: The Esther wording for saris, kept through the book. The seven names follow the traditional Protestant spellings.

source.text: לְ֠הָבִיא אֶת־וַשְׁתִּ֧י הַמַּלְכָּ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּכֶ֣תֶר מַלְכ֑וּת לְהַרְא֨וֹת הָֽעַמִּ֤ים וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ אֶת־יָפְיָ֔הּ כִּֽי־טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה הִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: to bring Vashti the queen before the king with [the] crown of royalty, to show the peoples and the princes her beauty, for good of appearance [was] she.

en.L: to bring Vashti the queen before the king with the royal crown, to show the peoples and the princes her beauty, for she was lovely to look at.
en.B: to bring Queen Vashti before the king, wearing her royal crown, so that he could show off her beauty to the peoples and the officials, for she was very beautiful.
en.R: He told them to bring Queen Vashti to him, wearing her royal crown. He wanted to show the people and the leaders how beautiful she was, because she was a lovely woman.

es.L: para traer a la reina Vasti delante del rey con la corona real, para mostrar a los pueblos y a los príncipes su belleza, porque [era] hermosa de aspecto.
es.B: que trajeran a la reina Vasti ante el rey, con su corona real, para lucir su belleza ante los pueblos y los jefes, porque era muy hermosa.
es.R: Les mandó traer a la reina Vasti, con su corona real. Quería mostrar a la gente y a los dirigentes lo hermosa que era, porque era una mujer muy bella.

fr.L: d’amener Vashti la reine devant le roi avec la couronne royale, pour montrer aux peuples et aux princes sa beauté, car elle [était] belle à voir.
fr.B: d’amener la reine Vashti devant le roi, coiffée de sa couronne royale, pour faire admirer sa beauté aux peuples et aux hauts fonctionnaires, car elle était très belle.
fr.R: Il leur a dit d’amener la reine Vashti devant lui, avec sa couronne royale. Il voulait montrer aux gens et aux dirigeants combien elle était belle, car c’était une très belle femme.

sw.L: wamlete Vashti malkia mbele ya mfalme na taji la kifalme, ili kuwaonyesha watu wa mataifa na wakuu uzuri wake, kwa maana yeye [alikuwa] mzuri wa sura.
sw.B: wamlete malkia Vashti mbele ya mfalme akiwa amevaa taji lake la kifalme, ili awaonyeshe watu wa mataifa na maafisa uzuri wake, kwa maana alikuwa mzuri sana.
sw.R: Aliwaambia wamlete malkia Vashti kwake, akiwa amevaa taji lake la kifalme. Alitaka kuwaonyesha watu na viongozi jinsi alivyokuwa mzuri, kwa sababu alikuwa mwanamke mrembo.

vi.L: để đưa hoàng hậu Vả-thi đến trước mặt vua với vương miện hoàng gia, để cho các dân và các quan trưởng thấy nhan sắc của bà, vì bà có dung mạo đẹp đẽ.
vi.B: đưa hoàng hậu Vả-thi đến trước mặt vua, đội vương miện hoàng hậu, để vua khoe nhan sắc của bà với các dân và các quan chức, vì bà rất xinh đẹp.
vi.R: Vua bảo họ đưa hoàng hậu Vả-thi đến, đội vương miện của hoàng hậu. Vua muốn cho dân chúng và những người lãnh đạo thấy hoàng hậu đẹp biết bao, vì bà là một người phụ nữ rất đẹp.

ko.L: 왕후 와스디를 왕관을 쓴 채 왕 앞으로 데려오게 하였으니, 백성들과 대신들에게 그 아름다움을 보이려는 것이었다. 그가 보기에 아름다웠기 때문이다.
ko.B: 왕후 와스디에게 왕관을 씌워 왕 앞으로 데려오라고 하였다. 그 아름다움을 백성들과 대신들에게 자랑하려는 것이었다. 왕후는 매우 아름다웠다.
ko.R: 왕은 그들에게 왕후 와스디가 왕관을 쓰고 자기 앞으로 오게 하라고 했다. 왕후가 얼마나 아름다운지 사람들과 지도자들에게 보여 주고 싶었던 것이다. 왕후는 정말 아름다운 여인이었다.

decisions.choice: with the crown of royalty: wearing the queen's crown
decisions.reason: The crown shows her rank. Later Jewish retellings read the words as "wearing only the crown", but the text does not say this.

decisions.choice: to show her beauty to the peoples and the princes: to display the queen before a gathering of men who had been drinking
decisions.reason: The queen is to be shown as part of the king's wealth (verse 4). The text does not say why she refused, and it does not judge her.

decisions.choice: show off (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Show off" keeps the sense of display, as in verse 4, where the same verb is used of his riches.

source.text: וַתְּמָאֵ֞ן הַמַּלְכָּ֣ה וַשְׁתִּ֗י לָבוֹא֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּיַ֣ד הַסָּרִיסִ֑ים וַיִּקְצֹ֤ף הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַחֲמָת֖וֹ בָּעֲרָ֥ה בֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And refused the queen Vashti to come at [the] word of the king which [was] by [the] hand of the eunuchs; and was angry the king greatly, and his rage burned in him.

en.L: But Queen Vashti refused to come at the word of the king that was [sent] by the hand of the eunuchs. And the king was very angry, and his rage burned within him.
en.B: But Queen Vashti refused to come at the king's command, which the eunuchs brought her. The king became furious, and his anger burned within him.
en.R: But Queen Vashti refused to come when the officials gave her the king's order. This made the king very angry. He was burning with rage.

es.L: Pero la reina Vasti rehusó venir a la palabra del rey [enviada] por mano de los eunucos. Y el rey se enojó mucho, y su ira ardió en él.
es.B: Pero la reina Vasti se negó a venir por orden del rey, que le llevaron los eunucos. El rey se puso furioso, y su ira ardía dentro de él.
es.R: Pero la reina Vasti no quiso venir cuando los funcionarios le dieron la orden del rey. Esto enojó mucho al rey. Ardía de rabia.

fr.L: Mais la reine Vashti refusa de venir sur la parole du roi [transmise] par la main des eunuques. Et le roi s’irrita fort, et sa fureur brûla en lui.
fr.B: Mais la reine Vashti refusa de venir sur l’ordre du roi que les eunuques lui apportèrent. Le roi entra dans une grande colère, et sa fureur s’enflamma en lui.
fr.R: Mais la reine Vashti a refusé de venir quand les officiers lui ont transmis l’ordre du roi. Le roi s’est mis très en colère. Il brûlait de rage.

sw.L: Lakini malkia Vashti akakataa kuja kwa neno la mfalme [lililoletwa] kwa mkono wa matowashi. Na mfalme akaghadhibika sana, na hasira yake ikawaka ndani yake.
sw.B: Lakini malkia Vashti alikataa kuja kwa amri ya mfalme aliyoletewa na matowashi. Mfalme akakasirika mno, na hasira yake ikawaka ndani yake.
sw.R: Lakini malkia Vashti alikataa kuja wakati maafisa walipompa amri ya mfalme. Jambo hilo lilimkasirisha mfalme sana. Hasira yake iliwaka kama moto.

vi.L: Nhưng hoàng hậu Vả-thi từ chối đến theo lời vua [truyền] qua tay các hoạn quan. Và vua giận lắm, và cơn thịnh nộ bừng cháy trong lòng vua.
vi.B: Nhưng hoàng hậu Vả-thi không chịu đến theo lệnh vua mà các hoạn quan truyền lại. Vua nổi giận phừng phừng, cơn thịnh nộ bừng cháy trong lòng.
vi.R: Nhưng khi các quan chức truyền lệnh vua, hoàng hậu Vả-thi không chịu đến. Vua vô cùng tức giận. Lòng vua sôi sục cơn giận.

ko.L: 그러나 왕후 와스디가 내시들의 손을 통한 왕의 말에 오기를 거절하였다. 그러자 왕이 크게 노하여 그의 분노가 그 속에서 불타올랐다.
ko.B: 그러나 왕후 와스디는 내시들이 전한 왕의 명령을 받고도 오기를 거절했다. 왕은 몹시 화가 나서 속에서 분노가 타올랐다.
ko.R: 그러나 궁중 관리들이 왕의 명령을 전했을 때, 왕후 와스디는 오지 않겠다고 했다. 그러자 왕은 몹시 화가 났다. 분노가 불처럼 타올랐다.

decisions.choice: refused: a plain refusal, with no reason given
decisions.reason: The narrator reports only that she refused. Readers have offered reasons (modesty, dignity, the drunkenness of the guests), but the story moves straight to the king's anger and its results.

decisions.choice: his rage burned in him: his anger flared up
decisions.reason: Anger is pictured as a fire, as in Genesis 39:19. The king's anger rises and subsides through the story (2:1; 7:7, 10).

decisions.choice: by the hand of the eunuchs: carried by the eunuchs
decisions.reason: "By the hand of" means "through" a messenger (1:15).

decisions.choice: officials (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps its wording for the eunuchs of verse 10.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לַחֲכָמִ֖ים יֹדְעֵ֣י הָֽעִתִּ֑ים כִּי־כֵן֙ דְּבַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִפְנֵ֕י כָּל־יֹדְעֵ֖י דָּ֥ת וָדִֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the king to the wise men, knowers of the times, for thus [was the] manner of the king before all knowers of law and judgment,

en.L: And the king said to the wise men who knew the times (for this was the king's way before all who knew law and judgment,
en.B: Then the king spoke to the wise men who understood the times, for it was the king's practice to consult all who were experts in law and justice,
en.R: The king turned to his wise advisers, men who understood what to do at such times. It was the king's custom to ask the advice of experts in law and justice.

es.L: Y dijo el rey a los sabios que conocían los tiempos (porque así [era] la costumbre del rey ante todos los que conocían la ley y el derecho,
es.B: Entonces el rey habló con los sabios que entendían los tiempos, porque era costumbre del rey consultar a todos los expertos en la ley y el derecho,
es.R: El rey se dirigió a sus sabios consejeros, hombres que sabían qué hacer en momentos así. Era costumbre del rey pedir consejo a los expertos en la ley y la justicia.

fr.L: Et le roi dit aux sages qui connaissaient les temps (car telle [était] la manière du roi devant tous ceux qui connaissaient la loi et le droit,
fr.B: Alors le roi s’adressa aux sages qui comprenaient les temps, car le roi avait coutume de consulter tous les experts en matière de loi et de justice,
fr.R: Le roi s’est tourné vers ses sages conseillers, des hommes qui savaient quoi faire dans ces moments-là. Le roi avait l’habitude de demander l’avis des spécialistes de la loi et de la justice.

sw.L: Na mfalme akawaambia wenye hekima waliozijua nyakati (kwa maana ndivyo [ilivyokuwa] desturi ya mfalme mbele ya wote walioijua sheria na hukumu,
sw.B: Ndipo mfalme akazungumza na wenye hekima walioelewa nyakati, kwa maana ilikuwa desturi ya mfalme kutaka shauri kwa wote waliokuwa wataalamu wa sheria na haki,
sw.R: Mfalme aliwageukia washauri wake wenye hekima, watu waliojua la kufanya nyakati kama hizo. Ilikuwa desturi ya mfalme kuomba shauri kwa wataalamu wa sheria na haki.

vi.L: Và vua nói với những người khôn ngoan biết các thời (vì đó [là] cách của vua trước mọi người biết luật pháp và sự xét xử,
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua hỏi ý những người khôn ngoan am hiểu thời thế, vì vua có lệ bàn hỏi mọi người thông thạo luật pháp và công lý,
vi.R: Vua quay sang hỏi các cố vấn khôn ngoan của mình, là những người biết phải làm gì trong những lúc như thế. Vua thường hỏi ý kiến những người am hiểu luật pháp và công lý.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 때를 아는 지혜로운 자들에게 말하였다. (법과 재판을 아는 모든 자들 앞에 [묻는 것이] 왕의 관례였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러자 왕은 때를 분별하는 지혜로운 사람들에게 물었다. 법과 재판에 밝은 모든 사람에게 의견을 묻는 것이 왕의 관례였기 때문이다.
ko.R: 왕은 이런 때에 어떻게 해야 할지 아는 지혜로운 조언자들에게 물었다. 왕은 법과 정의에 밝은 사람들에게 조언을 구하곤 했다.

decisions.choice: who knew the times: who understood what the times required
alternatives: who knew the seasons and signs (astrologers)
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean people who read the stars to choose the right time to act; 1 Chronicles 12:33 uses it of men of Issachar who understood the times and knew what Israel should do. Here the advisers are lawyers ("law and judgment"), so the sense is probably good judgment about what to do, though Persian kings did also consult star-readers.

decisions.choice: for thus was the manner of the king: a comment explaining the consultation
decisions.reason: The clause tells why the king asks advisers: matters of the king were laid before experts in law. Verse 14 continues the comment by naming them, and the king's question follows in verse 15.

decisions.choice: law and judgment: law and its application in rulings
decisions.reason: The first word is the Persian loanword dat (verse 8); the second is the Hebrew word for a legal judgment or case.

decisions.choice: Readable closes the sentence here; Literal and Balanced keep it open
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the king's words do not begin until verse 15. Literal shows this by keeping verses 13 and 14 as one parenthesis, and Balanced runs on with commas to a colon before the question; Readable ends each verse as a sentence and supplies "He asked them" in verse 15.

decisions.choice: Balanced closes the sentence at the end of the verse
alternatives: Running on to verse 15 as the English Balanced does
decisions.reason: A Korean sentence cannot stay open across a list of names and then reach its verb two verses later; Balanced ends each verse as a sentence, and Literal shows the Hebrew parenthesis with brackets ( ... ) as the English Literal does.
